provenance.review_method: A read-only subagent reviewed this partition from source facts and captured observations without seeing prior labels; the main assistant reconciled the recommendations with the sources. A separate subagent reviewed the low-reasoning partition. Subagent participation is not independent human validation.
provenance.rubric: Direct requires personal work or current responsibility on this run's generated consultation need. An advisor may explain a related real process/work item to help understand the need or approach the appropriate practitioner; area expertise is not required, but an explainable source-to-need bridge is. Titles, mentions, and manager/remit-only ties do not establish advisor expertise; routing retains its separate evidence requirements. Judge contact usefulness, direct support, and original question premises independently of question format. Open conditional inquiries do not assert that a control or requirement exists; questions assuming undocumented contents, duties, or findings are unsupported. Impact hypotheses are not false merely because they are absent from the idea or work sources. Null preserves uncertainty; false means reviewed and rejected. Card-ask labels describe the original captured cards, not today's neutral questions.
